scripts.text:
UPDATE [PSGL].[VisionMSB] 
   SET [PSGL].[VisionMSB].BatchId  = (SELECT MAX(BatchId)
   FROM [PSGL].[Vision_MSB_Batch])


UPDATE [PSGL].[VisionMSB] 
SET Counts = VWC.[Counts]
FROM [PSGL].[VisionWarpCount] VWC
 JOIN [PSGL].[VisionMSB] MSB ON VWC.[Group] = MSB.[Group]
AND VWC.[Class] = MSB.[Class] AND VWC.[Plan] = MSB.[Plan]

DELETE FROM .[PSGL].[VisionMSB] WHERE Counts IS NULL


UPDATE [PSGL].[VisionMSB] 
SET DbTotalAmt = Counts*DebitAmt
FROM [PSGL].[VisionMSB] 


UPDATE [PSGL].[VisionMSB]
